name: 暴杀残雨之夜The Rainy Night
detailed_description:
• Game Introduction:

You're staying at your uncle's house as a guest, juggling high school studies and part-time work to save up some cash. At school and work, you'll meet all kinds of people: a junior who’s a bit creepy but always seems to follow you around, a senior who used to act like a prince but got demoted to your class, a really kind bookstore manager, and even a mysterious dog-person boxer. You can choose how to interact with them—be friendly, serious, or maybe even take advantage of the situation. It’s all up to you!

  • Character Introduction:

Yuexiang Lihua - She’s got cat-like features and can transform pretty well. Her last name comes from her mom. Her name fits perfectly with her brother’s, especially under the moonlight in the mountains where flowers bloom. After her family faced a tragedy, she ended up living with her uncle. Right now, she’s just a regular high school student trying to make ends meet while saving for college.

(The character played by the player cannot have its name changed due to the plot requirements, but a nickname or pet name can be customized.)

  • Playable Character Introductions:

Meixing  Ji- He’s an orc with salamander-like abilities and can transform quite a bit. He’s a rich kid who just transferred to Orchid Middle School. His family doesn’t seem to care much about him, so he’s pretty quiet and shy. But don’t underestimate him—he’s incredibly persistent when he sets his mind on something. Once he latches onto you, it’s hard to shake him off. Kind of like morning glory vines that won’t let go unless... well, you know.

Fenghe She- He’s got snake-like qualities and can transform too. He’s like a prince at Orchid High School, super smart and doing great in school. But then he failed an important exam in his senior year and got moved down to your class. One day, you accidentally found out he has pica (yeah, eating weird stuff). Since becoming your classmate, he’s been acting extra interested in you, even writing you this strange love letter. What’s going on with him?

Yushan Jiao - She’s another orc, but she’s really good at transforming. She runs the Moonlight Bookstore and is like a big sister figure—kind and caring. But sometimes, she feels distant, like looking at a mountain through fog.

Shanye Lihua- This one’s a beastman with canine features and not much transformation ability. He’s a new boxer in the underground arena, mysterious and cold. But when you see him, you feel strangely close to him. Turns out, he’s actually your long-lost brother who was kidnapped years ago. Now, he’ll stick by you no matter what—as a lover or as a brother.

Game Type and Play Method:

This is a Yotsuba AVG visual novel. Your choices will lead to different endings, with lots of branches and twists. Every decision you make affects what happens next.

  • Production Team Info:

茶斩刀制作组

  • Lightning Warning: Be Alert and Take Precautions

Some choices might be selfish, dramatic, twisted, or morally questionable.

It also includes disturbing content like crime, self-harm, suicide, blood, weird stuff, and messed-up emotions. All the characters have either mental or physical issues. And there’s one female character who could become a potential love interest.
